metadataRaw.title: SAFELY Pop the Base of the Neck
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that may end in a satisfying self pop, crack or release at the base of the neck.

This exercise works by helping to release upper trapezius muscle tightness, while offering a deep opening stretch at the base of the neck.

Let us know how it works for you!
